profile.description: Run isolated-copy intra-kernel GPU profiling with 4-gate verification (SASS/spill, bitwise output, events, overhead), HMAC seal, and SW+HW causal bottleneck report.

megakernel-audit.description: Fast isolated-copy Sparse Attention / GDN / MoE megakernel profiler (with cached baseline builds) and 4-gate verifier returning cross-SM straggler skew, causal opportunities, and HMAC seal.

analyze.description: Run deterministic SW+HW causal bottleneck attribution (calibrated roofline ceilings, straggler correlation, overlap headroom, negative-ROI guardrails) on a captured trace/summary JSON.

compare-rounds.description: Compute round-to-round optimization diff between incumbent and candidate causal reports (eliminated/persisting/new bottlenecks, revert flag, next-round directive).

plan-context.description: Plan low-overhead recorder state placement (single-register bit-packed default vs 16B shared-memory + __noinline__ fallback) and compiler flags from kernel source and resource limits.

verify-seal.description: Fail-closed HMAC-SHA256 verification of a WeaveProfiler episode seal and bound artifact digests.

weaveprofiler.description: Intra-kernel GPU profiling (CUDA/HIP/Triton/CuTeDSL on H20/B300/MI308X) with 1-reg bit-packed capture, compiler spill/STL gates, and SW+HW causal bottleneck attribution.
